name: Flex
summary: A flexbox container with the DS spacing scale baked into `gap` — direction, align, justify, wrap, and a one-line `scroll` row that fades its clipped edge.
highlights: Flexbox container with the DS spacing scale baked into gap
scroll: a one-line chip or toggle row that fades the edge with more to see
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-flex> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `gap` takes the named steps small/middle/large (8/16/24) or a raw pixel number, and direction/align/justify/wrap map straight to flexbox. Layout only — it never paints a background. `scroll` keeps a chip or toggle row on one line inside its own box and fades only the edge that has more to see, so the page never scrolls sideways. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Gap scale
spec.value: small 8 · middle 16 · large 24 (or a raw px number)

spec.label: Direction
spec.value: row · row-reverse · column · column-reverse (or `vertical` for column)

spec.label: Scroll row
spec.value: `scroll`: one line, scrolls sideways in its own box, no scrollbar; the edge with more to see fades over up to 24px, growing with the distance left (none at an edge already reached); 4px block padding keeps focus rings unclipped

spec.label: Text colour
spec.value: inherited from the parent; Flex sets none

props.name: gap
props.desc: Space between items — named DS step (8/16/24) or a raw pixel number

props.name: vertical
props.desc: Stack in a column — AntD's boolean shorthand for direction=column (direction wins if both set)

props.name: direction
props.desc: Main-axis direction (flex-direction) — the full matrix; overrides `vertical`

props.name: justify
props.type: start | center | end | space-between | space-around | space-evenly

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow items to wrap onto multiple lines

props.name: scroll
props.desc: Keep a row on one line and let it scroll sideways inside its own box, fading the start or end edge only while there is more to see that way. Row direction only; wins over wrap. Items keep their width; Tab scrolls a clipped item clear of the fade

whenToUse.when: arranging a block of items in one dimension with consistent DS spacing
you need two-dimensional rows-and-columns, not a single flow
you only need even gaps between a small inline set of items

a chip or toggle row (filters, presets, a Customise row) must stay on one line in a narrow box; it scrolls sideways and fades the clipped edge. If the items can wrap, use wrap instead: wrapping shows every choice at once

opinion.note: Keep gaps on the named scale (small/middle/large) so spacing stays consistent across surfaces — reach for a raw pixel number only for a genuine one-off. Flex is layout, never decoration: it paints no background.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Flex cell; spec derived from the DS spacing scale (8/16/24) + AntD Flex conventions (gap steps, direction/align/justify/wrap). A deliberate, documented layout extension; the only visual token it binds is inherited text colour.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.
